description: location.hash — fragment, fully attacker-controllable, never sent to server
location.search — query string, attacker-controllable
location.href — full URL read; downstream tagger should disambiguate from assignment
location.pathname — URL path, partially attacker-controllable
document.URL — full URL
document.referrer — Referer header value, attacker-controllable
document.cookie — disclosure / attacker-influenced via Set-Cookie or other origins on subdomain
new URLSearchParams(...) — typically wraps location.search
addEventListener('message', ...) — postMessage receive; e.data is cross-origin input
obj.onmessage = ... — postMessage receive handler
localStorage.getItem(...) — persistent storage, may be attacker-influenced via earlier XSS
sessionStorage.getItem(...) — same as localStorage but per-tab
Bracket assignment on __proto__ or constructor.prototype with dynamic key — prototype pollution write (Stage 1)
Direct __proto__ property write — prototype pollution write (Stage 1)
Deep-merge / extend / assign helper receiving user-controlled object — prototype pollution write (Stage 1, regex-only, may FP on benign merges)
process.argv — attacker-controlled CLI arguments
process.env value read — low severity unless used in security-sensitive context
fs path argument that may be user-controlled — taint-driven, regex path suppressed via AST_COVERED
data passed to child_process exec/spawn — attacker-controlled when arg is dynamic
Express req.files / req.file — uploaded file metadata (filename, mimetype)
Next.js App Router searchParams — URL query parameters, attacker-controlled
Next.js Pages Router router.query / useRouter().query — URL params
Next.js getServerSideProps / getStaticProps context.params / context.query / props.params / props.query
Next.js API route handler req.body / req.query / req.cookies (pages/api/ and app/api/)
Angular ActivatedRoute params / snapshot.params / queryParams / queryParamMap — URL route params
Angular HttpClient response body — may carry attacker-influenced data
Angular component reading localStorage / sessionStorage — can be polluted by prior XSS
Vue Router route.params / route.query — attacker-controlled URL segments
Nuxt 3 useRoute() composable — URL params and query
SvelteKit load function params / event.params / event.url.searchParams
Electron ipcRenderer.on / once message data — originates from renderer (web content)
Electron webContents.loadURL / executeJavaScript input — high-risk in main process
